title: Shared Count · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Shared Count · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players; apart from the numbers, they do not signal to each other. The two players take turns saying the next number from one to six without speaking at the same time. They reach six in the correct order without simultaneous speech. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Shared Count, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
They reach six in the correct order without simultaneous speech.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: They reach six in the correct order without simultaneous speech.
